proposal.description: The capture gate is held open while the CPLD's latch trip is asserted, so the trip that stops the converter is sure to be seen. Because latch_assert is held until reset, the gate never closes after a latch trip.
proposal.reason: latch_assert stays high until rst_n after a strike-out trip, while the supervisor sits in S_OFF. If the host reads fault_reg in that state, the original stays empty, but the mutant sets LATCH_ASSERT again on the next clock. Any OTP or UVLO that arrives later, such as a power-down UVLO, is also recorded.

proposal.description: A host read clears fault_time only when no cause is live. The episode is treated as still open while any cause persists, so its start time survives the read even though fault_reg is cleared.
proposal.reason: After a latch trip, latch_assert stays high with the converter stopped. A host read then empties fault_reg, and in the original fault_time goes to 0. In the mutant fault_time keeps the old episode start time next to an empty fault_reg, and no new episode can re-stamp it while the converter is stopped.
